title: Layers uses in enemy repathing
author: Such--Balance
selftext:
Made a repathing system to pretty much always target tiles with enemies instead of waiting for the updated flowfield to reach them. I migrated both the enemy pathfinding as flow field propagation and border tracking logic over to c++ from in engine Godot. Highly recommend doing this is you encounter ups issues in some areas, as know in the days of ai, its pretty easy and could potentially get you massive performance gains.

Here you can see visually that that a wall-off will both track that walls border, and track the historic tile pathing of enemies. 

This way updating actual useful and needed tiles for enemy repathing can happen many times sooner than with regular flowfield updating.

Probably could be made way more optimized even. At the very least i need some additional system or rule to reduce the number of historic tile visits that are no longer needed (blue squares).
